card.name: Linking words after a drug or subject noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs (with, that, are, as, without, carries) that come right after a subject noun phrase in label sentences. The next words usually add a condition, such as caution, risk or timing.

modes.label: The phrase "use with caution"
modes.description: The word "with" after "used" before the word caution.
modes.example: should be used<< with>> caution. 7.8 Dopamin

modes.label: Verb or link after a noun phrase
modes.description: A verb or conjunction right after a subject like options, exposures or tablets.
modes.example: alternative treatment options<< are>> inadequate [see Warnings and Preca

modes.label: Word after a general noun
modes.description: A word after a non-drug noun, such as concentrations, in a policy sentence.
modes.example: stabilize greenhouse gas (GHG)<< concentrations>> without jeopardizing sustainable development, he
